text:
mira: Heads up — trying to onboard community model `xglm-small-v2` and conversion fails on startup. getting a bunch of config.json incompat warnings and then a KV error.
sam: what do the warnings say? paste the config block?
mira: gist of hf config:
```json
{
  "model_type": "gpt2-like",
  "n_heads": 32,
  "num_key_value_heads": 16,
  "max_position_embeddings": 8192,
  "rope_scaling": {"type": "linear", "factor": 2.0},
  "sliding_window": 256
}
```
oliver: ah — `num_key_value_heads` is the usual culprit. Redwood runtime expects either omitted (imply match) or explicitly equal to `n_heads`/2 based on our conversion rules. HF having 16 with 32 heads is fine for HF but our KW layout code checks strict mapping and bails.
jess: also note `sliding_window` is not part of our converter namespace — we translate `kv_window` differently. that mismatch can change how max_position is interpreted.
mira: error log snippet from conversion tool:
```
ERROR: KVHeadSanity: expected num_kv_heads=16 -> runtime_kv_heads=32 mismatch
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "rw_convert.py", line 214, in apply_config
    validate_kv_heads(cfg)
  File "rw_convert.py", line 89, in validate_kv_heads
    raise ConfigIncompatError(msg)
ConfigIncompatError: KV head mapping incompatible with runtime layout
```
sam: two quick options: 1) set `num_key_value_heads` to `null` or remove it so converter infers; 2) add a conversion flag `--allow-kv-head-mismatch` if you want to force a mapping (risking subtle kv-indexing bugs).
mira: tried removing it — converter then inferred but got a different downstream: generation logits slightly degraded and attention alignment warnings.
oliver: that smells like `rope_scaling` difference + sliding window semantics. HF's `rope_scaling` uses linear factor on old RoPE freq table; we implement scaled-freq vs scaled-positions variants. converter currently only supports `{\"type\":\"alpha_scale\"}` patterns.
jess: workaround we used on another bring-up: convert rope to explicit `position_buckets` before conversion, or set `rope_scaling": {"type":"legacy_linear", "factor":2.0}` and run `rw_convert --rope-compat legacy_linear`.
mira: ok will try. one more question — `max_position_embeddings` is 8192 here but runtime capped at 4096 by GPU kernel. should we patch config to 4096?
sam: yes patching to runtime-supported max is safer; leaving 8192 will cause truncation + silent wrap in KV indexing for some models.
quant-bot: automated note: quant experiments with this model showed 0.7% perplexity delta when forced to 4096 vs 8192 on short-context evals, but long-context tasks dropped significantly.
mira: thanks. plan: try removing `num_key_value_heads`, set `rope_scaling` to legacy form, set `max_position_embeddings` to 4096 and re-run conversion with `--debug-kv-map`. I'll report back.
oliver: if you hit the kv-map debug output, paste it — we added an ASCII map that helps visualize head->kv index mapping.
jess: also check chat-template special tokens if this is a chat variant — we've seen an extra `` token cause off-by-one windows when sliding_window is present. :facepalm:
mira: good call — it's actually chat-ish. will scan tokenizer and chat template.
sam: ping me if you want a quick pair to interpret the kv-map.
mira: will do — thanks all :thumbsup:
